# Waterloo Heating & Cooling

> Waterloo Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Waterloo, Waterloo Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (548) 490-6741  |  Email: contact@waterlooheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://waterlooheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Waterloo, Cambridge, Kitchener, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
